description: Token List. Calls only GET /v4/tokens and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Token-2022 and SPL token lists in the form of paginated lists of all tracked Solana tokens with summary metrics.

name.description: Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the token name.

sortByAsc.description: Optional ascending sort field specification. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Optional descending sort field specification. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

symbol.description: Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the token symbol.

name: list-tokens
title: Token List
